overview: The Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee met to approve the summer newsletter, coordinate outreach for upcoming ward meetings, and discuss options for updating the city's 1974 noise ordinance.

items.title: Summer Newsletter
items.summary: Approved and released the municipal newsletter covering city council activities and resolutions from July and August.

items.title: Ward Meetings
items.summary: Reviewed scheduling, logistics, and outreach strategies for upcoming neighborhood ward meetings starting with Ward 1 on September 23rd.

items.title: Noise Ordinance Update
items.summary: Kept in committee a resolution to update the city's noise ordinance after reviewing regulatory approaches from peer municipalities and discussing enforcement challenges.
